title: LaserData Memory
description: Durable, shared agent memory exposed as tools, backed by LaserData (Apache Iggy) via the Laser SDK.

Exposes four agent tools: 'remember' stores a statement, 'recall' returns the most relevant items, 'improve' reinforces a memory with feedback, and 'forget' deletes one. Pick your deployment (local Apache Iggy or LaserData Cloud), set the connection string and a namespace, and it works; point several agents at the same namespace to share one durable memory.

laserdata.local.connection_string.title: Connection string
laserdata.local.connection_string.description: Apache Iggy connection string in the form user:password@host:port, e.g. iggy:iggy@localhost:8090. The server must be a VSR-enabled Iggy build: use laser-stack (its ./scripts/up prints a ready connection string); stock pre-VSR Iggy images cannot talk to this SDK. A containerized engine needs an address reachable from the container, e.g. host.docker.internal.

laserdata.cloud.connection_string.title: Connection string
laserdata.cloud.connection_string.description: LaserData Cloud endpoint in the form user:password@host:port: the user and password from your deployment's Credentials tab, the domain and TCP port from its Overview tab. TLS is automatic for *.laserdata.cloud hosts (the SDK ships the LaserData root CA). The deployment must serve VSR, created on/after 2026-07-31; recreate older ones.

laserdata.namespace.title: Namespace
laserdata.namespace.description: The memory scope every call reads and writes, e.g. customer:42. The agent can pass a namespace per call; a namespace is required on the call or here.

laserdata.stream.title: Stream
laserdata.stream.description: The Iggy stream the memory topics live in, pinned as the connection's default stream. All nodes sharing one memory must use the same stream.

laserdata.allow_namespace_override.title: Allow namespace override
laserdata.allow_namespace_override.description: When on (default), the agent may pass a different namespace per call. Turn off to lock every call to the configured namespace.

laserdata.folded.title: Folded recall
laserdata.folded.description: When on (default), 'recall' folds the durable memory topic in-process, which works against plain Apache Iggy and LaserData Cloud alike (verified live). Turn off only to read a managed KV view on a deployment that serves one.

laserdata.recall_limit.title: Recall limit
laserdata.recall_limit.description: Maximum number of memory items to retrieve per recall.

laserdata.op_timeout.title: Operation timeout (s)
laserdata.op_timeout.description: Max seconds any single memory operation (including the first connect) may take before it fails.
